en: The LORD tells Abram to leave his land and family and go to the land he will show him.
God promises to make him a great nation; in him all the families of the earth will be blessed.
Abram goes, at seventy-five, from Haran with his wife Sarai and his nephew Lot.
At Shechem the LORD says, "To your offspring I will give this land"; Abram builds an altar.
Between Bethel and Ai he builds another altar and calls on the name of the LORD.
Abram journeys on by stages toward the Negev.
zh: 耶和華吩咐亞伯蘭離開本地和親族，往他要指示的地方去。
神應許使他成為大國；地上的萬族都要因他得福。
亞伯蘭七十五歲時，帶着妻子撒萊和姪兒羅得離開哈蘭。
在示劍，耶和華說：「我要把這地賜給你的後代。」亞伯蘭就築了一座壇。
他在伯特利和艾之間又築了一座壇，呼求耶和華的名。
亞伯蘭一路遷移，漸漸往南地去。

about.en: Terah takes Abram from Ur to Haran
about.zh: 他拉帶亞伯蘭從吾珥到哈蘭

about.en: Stephen tells of Abraham's call
about.zh: 司提反講述亞伯拉罕蒙召

about.en: By faith Abraham went out, not knowing where
about.zh: 亞伯拉罕因着信出去，不知往哪裏去

about.en: The good news announced beforehand to Abraham
about.zh: 預先傳福音給亞伯拉罕

en: Ur was a great city in southern Iraq, excavated by Leonard Woolley in 1922–34; Haran is still a village, Harran, in southeast Turkey.
Shechem is Tell Balata, beside modern Nablus; Bethel is usually placed at Beitin, north of Jerusalem.
Abraham is often dated to about 2000–1800 BC, but the dates are uncertain and scholars differ.
zh: 吾珥是伊拉克南部的大城，1922至1934年由伍利發掘；哈蘭今天仍是土耳其東南部的一個村莊，名叫哈蘭。
示劍就是今天納布盧斯旁的巴拉塔丘；伯特利一般認為在耶路撒冷以北的貝廷。
亞伯拉罕的年代常被定在約公元前2000至1800年，但並不確定，學者看法不一。

en: Abram hears that his relative Lot has been taken captive by invading kings.
With 318 trained men he pursues them as far as Dan and brings back Lot and all the goods.
The king of Sodom comes out to meet Abram in the King's Valley.
Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, brings out bread and wine.
He blesses Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth; Abram gives him a tenth of everything.
Abram refuses to take even a thread or a sandal strap from the king of Sodom.
zh: 亞伯蘭聽見他的親人羅得被入侵的諸王擄去。
他帶着三百一十八個受過訓練的壯丁追趕到但，奪回了羅得和一切財物。
所多瑪王出來，到王谷迎接亞伯蘭。
撒冷王麥基洗德是至高的神的祭司，他帶着餅和酒出來。
他奉天地的主、至高的神祝福亞伯蘭；亞伯蘭把所得的十分之一給他。
亞伯蘭連一根線、一根鞋帶也不肯從所多瑪王那裏拿。

about.en: A priest forever, after the manner of Melchizedek
about.zh: 照着麥基洗德的樣式永遠為祭司

about.en: Melchizedek, king of righteousness and of peace
about.zh: 麥基洗德是公義的王、平安的王

about.en: Christ called a priest in the order of Melchizedek
about.zh: 基督照麥基洗德的等次為祭司

en: Salem is commonly identified with Jerusalem; Psalm 76 sets Salem beside Zion.
Dan lay at the far north of the land, at the foot of Mount Hermon; its ruins are at Tel Dan in northern Israel.
Giving a tenth (a tithe) of produce or plunder to a king or a temple was a known custom in the ancient Near East.
zh: 撒冷一般認為就是耶路撒冷；詩篇76篇把撒冷和錫安並列。
但在那地的最北端，位於黑門山腳下；遺址在今以色列北部的但丘。
把出產或戰利品的十分之一獻給君王或神廟，是古代近東常見的習俗。

title.en: God's promise: land, nation, and a blessing for every nation
title.zh: 神的應許：土地、國家，萬國得福

en: Abram is childless; God brings him outside: "Count the stars. So will your offspring be."
Abram believes the LORD, and he credits it to him as righteousness.
A smoking firepot and a flaming torch pass between cut animals; God gives the land by covenant.
At ninety-nine Abram is renamed Abraham, "father of a multitude of nations"; circumcision is the covenant's sign.
Sarai is renamed Sarah; God says she will bear a son, Isaac, and the covenant will be with him.
Paul writes that scripture announced the good news to Abraham: "In you all the nations will be blessed."
The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed, who is Christ.
zh: 亞伯蘭沒有兒子；神領他出去，說：「你數數天上的星，你的後代也要這樣。」
亞伯蘭信耶和華，耶和華就以此算為他的義。
冒煙的爐和燒着的火把從切開的牲畜中間經過；神與他立約，把這地賜給他。
亞伯蘭九十九歲時改名亞伯拉罕，意思是「多國的父」；割禮是立約的記號。
撒萊改名撒拉；神說她要生一個兒子，名叫以撒，神要與他立約。
保羅寫道，經上預先傳福音給亞伯拉罕：「萬國都必因你得福。」
應許是向亞伯拉罕和他的後裔說的，這後裔就是基督。

about.en: Abraham did not waver concerning God's promise
about.zh: 亞伯拉罕對神的應許總沒有疑惑

about.en: Passing between the pieces of a calf to make a covenant
about.zh: 從劈開的牛犢中間經過立約

about.en: God swore by himself to Abraham
about.zh: 神指着自己向亞伯拉罕起誓

about.en: Sarah gives birth to Isaac
about.zh: 撒拉生了以撒

en: Cutting animals in two and passing between the pieces was a way of making a covenant; Jeremiah 34:18–19 describes the same rite.
Circumcision was also practised by some other ancient peoples, such as the Egyptians, but not by all.
The "river of Egypt" is often taken as the Wadi el-Arish in Sinai; the Euphrates flows through Syria and Iraq.
zh: 把牲畜劈成兩半，從中間經過，是古代立約的方式；耶利米書34章18至19節記載了同樣的禮儀。
其他一些古代民族，如埃及人，也行割禮，但不是所有民族都這樣做。
「埃及河」常被認為是西奈半島的阿里什乾河；伯拉河（幼發拉底河）流經敘利亞和伊拉克。

title.en: Sodom and Gomorrah; the pillar of salt

en: Abraham welcomes three visitors at Mamre and serves them a meal.
The LORD says Sarah will have a son; Sarah laughs. "Is anything too hard for the LORD?"
Abraham pleads for Sodom: will God spare it for fifty righteous? For ten? God says yes.
Two angels come to Lot in Sodom; the men of the city surround the house and are struck blind.
The angels lead Lot, his wife and two daughters out: "Don't look back."
The LORD rains down sulfur and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah.
Lot's wife looks back and becomes a pillar of salt; Abraham sees the smoke rising.
zh: 亞伯拉罕在幔利接待三位客人，預備飯給他們吃。
耶和華說撒拉要生一個兒子；撒拉暗笑。「耶和華豈有難成的事嗎？」
亞伯拉罕為所多瑪求情：若有五十個義人，神會饒恕那城嗎？十個呢？神都答應了。
兩位天使來到所多瑪羅得那裏；城裏的人圍住房子，被擊打得眼睛昏迷。
天使領羅得、他的妻子和兩個女兒出城，說：「不可回頭看。」
耶和華使硫磺和火降在所多瑪和蛾摩拉。
羅得的妻子回頭一看，就變成了一根鹽柱；亞伯拉罕看見煙氣上騰。

about.en: Some have entertained angels without knowing it
about.zh: 有人不知不覺就接待了天使

about.en: Jesus: "Remember Lot's wife!"
about.zh: 耶穌說：「要記念羅得的妻子！」

about.en: Sodom condemned, righteous Lot rescued
about.zh: 所多瑪被定罪，義人羅得被救

en: Sodom and Gomorrah were "cities of the plain" near the Dead Sea; their exact sites are unknown, and scholars differ.
The Dead Sea, about 430 m below sea level, is the lowest place on land and very salty; Mount Sodom on its southwest shore is a ridge of rock salt.
Three seahs of flour was a large amount, perhaps about 20 litres; measures of the time are not known exactly.
zh: 所多瑪和蛾摩拉是死海附近的「平原的城」；確實位置不詳，學者看法不一。
死海低於海平面約430公尺，是陸地上最低的地方，含鹽量極高；西南岸的所多瑪山是一道岩鹽山脊。
三細亞細麵是很多的麵粉，大約20公升；當時的量器不能確知。

en: God tests Abraham: "Take your son, your only son Isaac, and offer him on a mountain in Moriah."
Abraham sets out early; on the third day he sees the place and lays the wood on Isaac.
Isaac asks, "Where is the lamb?" Abraham says, "God will provide the lamb himself."
Abraham binds Isaac on the altar and takes the knife.
The angel of the LORD calls from heaven, "Do not lay your hand on the boy."
Abraham offers a ram caught in a thicket in place of his son and names the place "The LORD will provide."
God swears to bless him and multiply his offspring; in them all nations will be blessed.
zh: 神試驗亞伯拉罕：「你帶着你獨一的兒子以撒，到摩利亞地的一座山上，把他獻為燔祭。」
亞伯拉罕清早起身；第三天他看見那地方，就把柴放在以撒身上。
以撒問：「羔羊在哪裏呢？」亞伯拉罕說：「神必親自預備作燔祭的羔羊。」
亞伯拉罕把以撒捆綁，放在壇上，拿起刀來。
耶和華的使者從天上呼叫：「你不可在這孩子身上下手。」
亞伯拉罕把一隻角扣在稠密小樹中的公羊獻上，代替他的兒子，給那地方起名叫「耶和華必預備」。
神起誓要賜福給他，使他的後代眾多；萬國都要因他的後代得福。

about.en: By faith Abraham offered up Isaac
about.zh: 亞伯拉罕因着信把以撒獻上

about.en: Abraham, called God's friend
about.zh: 亞伯拉罕被稱為神的朋友

about.en: God did not spare his own Son
about.zh: 神不愛惜自己的兒子

about.en: Solomon builds the temple on Mount Moriah
about.zh: 所羅門在摩利亞山建殿

en: 2 Chronicles 3:1 places Solomon's temple on Mount Moriah; Moriah is traditionally the Temple Mount in Jerusalem.
Beersheba lay in the Negev; its ruins, Tel Beer Sheva, are beside the modern city, about 75 km south of Jerusalem.
zh: 歷代志下3章1節說所羅門的聖殿建在摩利亞山上；傳統認為摩利亞就是耶路撒冷的聖殿山。
別是巴在南地；遺址別是巴丘就在今天的城市旁邊，在耶路撒冷以南約75公里。

en: Abraham makes his servant swear to find a wife for Isaac from his own relatives, not from the Canaanites.
The servant takes ten camels to the city of Nahor and stops by the well at evening.
He prays that the woman who offers to water his camels will be the one the LORD has chosen.
Rebekah comes, gives him a drink and draws water for all his camels.
The servant worships the LORD; Laban and Bethuel say, "This has come from the LORD."
Asked if she will go with the man, Rebekah says, "I will go."
Isaac meets her in the field; she becomes his wife, and he loves her.
zh: 亞伯拉罕叫僕人起誓，要從自己的親族中為以撒娶妻，不可娶迦南的女子。
僕人帶着十匹駱駝到了拿鶴的城，傍晚停在井旁。
他禱告：願那肯給他駱駝喝水的女子，就是耶和華所選定的。
利百加來了，給他水喝，又為他所有的駱駝打水。
僕人敬拜耶和華；拉班和彼土利說：「這事是出於耶和華。」
家人問利百加肯不肯跟這人去，她說：「我去。」
以撒在田間遇見她；她成了以撒的妻子，以撒愛她。

about.en: Rebekah's family: Nahor, Milcah and Bethuel
about.zh: 利百加的家族：拿鶴、密迦、彼土利

about.en: God's promise to Abraham passes to Isaac
about.zh: 神給亞伯拉罕的應許傳給以撒

about.en: Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in Jesus' family line
about.zh: 耶穌家譜中的亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各

en: Aram-naharaim, "Aram of the two rivers", was upper Mesopotamia, around Haran in southeast Turkey and northern Syria.
A thirsty camel can drink up to about 100 litres; watering ten camels meant many trips to the well.
A shekel weighed about 11.5 g; the gold nose ring of a beka was half a shekel.
zh: 兩河之間的亞蘭，就是美索不達米亞北部，在土耳其東南部的哈蘭和敘利亞北部一帶。
口渴的駱駝一次可喝約100公升水；為十匹駱駝打水要往返水井許多次。
一舍客勒約重11.5公克；重一比加的金鼻環就是半舍客勒。

en: Isaac prays for Rebekah; the LORD tells her, "Two nations are in your womb; the older will serve the younger."
Esau is born red and hairy; Jacob comes out grasping Esau's heel.
Esau, exhausted, sells his birthright to Jacob for bread and lentil stew.
Old and blind, Isaac sends Esau to hunt game so that he may bless him.
Rebekah dresses Jacob in Esau's clothes and goatskins, and Isaac blesses Jacob.
Esau cries out bitterly and plans to kill Jacob; Rebekah sends Jacob to Laban in Haran.
zh: 以撒為利百加祈求；耶和華對她說：「兩國在你腹內；將來大的要服事小的。」
以掃出生時身體發紅，渾身有毛；雅各出來時手抓住以掃的腳跟。
以掃累極了，為了餅和紅豆湯，把長子的名分賣給雅各。
以撒年老眼瞎，打發以掃去打獵，好為他祝福。
利百加給雅各穿上以掃的衣服，又用山羊羔的皮包他，以撒就為雅各祝福。
以掃放聲痛哭，想殺雅各；利百加打發雅各往哈蘭投奔拉班。

about.en: "The older will serve the younger"
about.zh: 「將來大的要服事小的」

about.en: Esau sold his birthright for a single meal
about.zh: 以掃因一點食物賣了長子的名分

about.en: "I loved Jacob, but Esau I hated"
about.zh: 「我愛雅各，惡以掃」

en: The birthright was the firstborn son's right, including a double share of the inheritance (Deut 21:17).
Edom, Esau's land, lay south and southeast of the Dead Sea, in modern southern Jordan.
zh: 長子的名分是長子的權利，包括承受雙份產業（申命記21章17節）。
以掃的地以東，在死海的南面和東南面，今約旦南部。

title.en: Jacob works for Rachel and Leah; Laban changes his wages
title.zh: 雅各為拉結和利亞服事；拉班改他的工價

en: At a well near Haran Jacob rolls away the stone and waters the sheep of his cousin Rachel.
Jacob works seven years for Rachel, and they seem like only a few days because he loves her.
Laban gives him Leah instead; Jacob marries Rachel too and works another seven years.
Jacob's wages are to be the speckled and spotted animals, and God makes his flocks grow.
Laban changes Jacob's wages ten times; the LORD tells Jacob to go back to his land.
Jacob leaves secretly; Laban pursues, and they make a covenant at a heap of stones.
zh: 雅各在哈蘭附近的井旁把石頭轉開，給表妹拉結的羊喝水。
雅各為拉結服事了七年，因為深愛她，就看這七年如同幾天。
拉班卻把利亞給了他；雅各又娶了拉結，再服事了七年。
雅各的工價是有斑點和花紋的牲畜，神使他的羊群興旺。
拉班十次改了雅各的工價；耶和華吩咐雅各回到本地去。
雅各暗中離開；拉班追趕他，二人在一堆石頭那裏立約。

about.en: On the way, Jacob's dream at Bethel
about.zh: 雅各途中在伯特利做的夢

about.en: Israel served for a wife and kept sheep
about.zh: 以色列為得妻子服事人、牧放羊群

about.en: Rachel and Leah built up the house of Israel
about.zh: 拉結和利亞建立以色列的家

en: Haran lay in Paddan-aram, in modern southeast Turkey; Gilead is the hill country east of the Jordan, in northern Jordan.
A wedding feast lasted a week (Gen 29:27; Judg 14:12).
Jacob served twenty years in all: fourteen for his two wives and six for his flock (Gen 31:41).
zh: 哈蘭在巴旦‧亞蘭，今土耳其東南部；基列是約旦河東的山區，在今約旦北部。
婚宴要延續七日（創世記29章27節；士師記14章12節）。
雅各一共服事了二十年：為兩個妻子十四年，為羊群六年（創世記31章41節）。

en: The LORD sees that Leah is unloved; she bears Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah.
Rachel has no children and gives Jacob her servant Bilhah, who bears Dan and Naphtali.
Leah gives Jacob her servant Zilpah, who bears Gad and Asher.
Leah bears Issachar and Zebulun, and a daughter, Dinah.
God remembers Rachel, and she bears Joseph.
Near Bethlehem Rachel dies giving birth to Benjamin; Jacob now has twelve sons.
zh: 耶和華見利亞失寵；她生了呂便、西緬、利未和猶大。
拉結沒有孩子，就把婢女辟拉給雅各，辟拉生了但和拿弗他利。
利亞把婢女悉帕給雅各，悉帕生了迦得和亞設。
利亞又生了以薩迦和西布倫，還有一個女兒底拿。
神記念拉結，她生了約瑟。
拉結在伯利恆附近生便雅憫時死了；雅各共有十二個兒子。

about.en: Jacob gathers his sons to tell them what will happen
about.zh: 雅各召集兒子們，告訴他們日後的事

about.en: Rachel weeping for her children
about.zh: 拉結哭她的兒女

about.en: Twelve thousand sealed from each tribe
about.zh: 每支派受印的一萬二千人

en: The twelve sons became the ancestors of the twelve tribes of Israel; Joseph's line became two tribes, Ephraim and Manasseh.
Each name is explained by a wordplay: Judah sounds like "praise" and Joseph like "may he add".
Rachel's Tomb, on the road at the edge of Bethlehem, is the traditional site of her grave.
zh: 十二個兒子成為以色列十二支派的祖先；約瑟的後代成為以法蓮和瑪拿西兩個支派。
每個名字都有諧音的解釋：猶大與「讚美」音近，約瑟與「願他再加」音近。
伯利恆城邊路旁的拉結墓，是傳統認為的拉結葬地。

title.en: God renames Jacob Israel; Jacob meets Esau
title.zh: 神給雅各改名以色列；雅各與以掃相見

en: Messengers tell Jacob that Esau is coming with four hundred men; Jacob is very afraid.
Jacob prays, "I am not worthy of all your faithful love," and sends herds ahead as a gift.
At the ford of the Jabbok a man wrestles with Jacob until daybreak and wrenches his hip.
Jacob will not let him go without a blessing; his name becomes Israel.
Jacob names the place Peniel: "I have seen God face to face"; he goes on limping.
Esau runs to meet Jacob, hugs him and kisses him, and they weep.
Jacob comes to Shechem, buys land and sets up an altar.
zh: 使者告訴雅各，以掃帶着四百人來了；雅各非常懼怕。
雅各禱告：「你向僕人所施的一切慈愛，我一點也不配得。」又把牲畜先送去作禮物。
在雅博渡口，有一個人與雅各摔跤直到黎明，扭傷了他的大腿窩。
雅各不肯放他走，要他祝福；雅各的名字就改為以色列。
雅各給那地方起名叫毗努伊勒：「我面對面見了神。」他走路一拐一拐的。
以掃跑來迎接雅各，抱住他，與他親嘴，兩人都哭了。
雅各來到示劍，買了一塊地，在那裏築了一座壇。

about.en: Jacob struggled with God and prevailed
about.zh: 雅各與神較力，並且得勝

about.en: God confirms the name Israel at Bethel
about.zh: 神在伯特利再次確立以色列之名

about.en: A father runs to embrace a returning son
about.zh: 父親跑去擁抱回家的兒子

en: The Jabbok is the Zarqa River in Jordan, which flows west into the Jordan River.
Letters found at Amarna in Egypt (1300s BC) show vassals bowing "seven times and seven times" before a ruler, as Jacob bows seven times.
zh: 雅博河就是今約旦境內的扎卡河，向西流入約旦河。
在埃及阿瑪納出土的書信（公元前十四世紀）中，屬國向君王「下拜七次又七次」，正如雅各下拜七次。

en: Israel loves Joseph more than his other sons and makes him a special robe; his brothers hate him.
Joseph dreams that his brothers' sheaves, and then the sun, moon and eleven stars, bow down to him.
Sent to find his brothers, Joseph finds them at Dothan; they plot to kill him.
Reuben persuades them to throw him into an empty pit instead.
At Judah's word they sell Joseph to traders going to Egypt for twenty pieces of silver.
They dip his robe in goat's blood; Jacob thinks a wild animal has eaten Joseph and mourns.
In Egypt Joseph is sold to Potiphar, captain of Pharaoh's guard.
zh: 以色列愛約瑟勝過愛其他兒子，給他做了一件特別的長袍；哥哥們都恨他。
約瑟夢見哥哥們的禾捆向他下拜，又夢見太陽、月亮和十一顆星向他下拜。
約瑟奉命去找哥哥們，在多坍找到他們；他們卻設計要殺他。
呂便勸他們不要殺他，只把他丟進一個沒有水的坑裏。
照着猶大的話，他們以二十塊銀子把約瑟賣給往埃及去的商人。
他們把約瑟的長袍蘸了山羊的血；雅各以為約瑟被野獸吃了，就為他悲哀。
約瑟在埃及被賣給法老的護衛長波提乏。

about.en: The patriarchs sold Joseph, but God was with him
about.zh: 先祖賣了約瑟，神卻與他同在

about.en: Joseph: "God sent me ahead of you"
about.zh: 約瑟說：「是神差我在你們以先來」

about.en: Joseph sold as a slave until his word came true
about.zh: 約瑟被賣為奴，直到他的話應驗

en: "Coat of many colors" comes from the old Greek and Latin translations; the Hebrew phrase is uncertain and may mean a long robe with sleeves.
Dothan is Tell Dothan, about 20 km north of Shechem, on a trade route from Gilead to Egypt.
Twenty shekels was the value set for a boy aged five to twenty in Leviticus 27:5.
zh: 「彩衣」一說來自古希臘文和拉丁文譯本；希伯來文原意不確定，可能是有袖的長袍。
多坍就是多坍丘，在示劍以北約20公里，位於從基列往埃及的商路上。
利未記27章5節規定，五歲到二十歲男子的價值是二十舍客勒。

en: The LORD is with Joseph; Potiphar puts him in charge of his whole household.
Joseph refuses his master's wife; she accuses him falsely, and he is put in prison.
In prison Joseph says to Pharaoh's cupbearer and baker, "Don't interpretations belong to God?"
The cupbearer is restored as Joseph said, but he forgets Joseph for two years.
Pharaoh dreams of seven fat and seven thin cows, and seven full and seven thin heads of grain.
Joseph says God is showing seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine.
Pharaoh puts Joseph in charge of all Egypt; Joseph stores grain, and all the world comes to buy.
zh: 耶和華與約瑟同在；波提乏派他管理全家。
約瑟拒絕主人的妻子；她誣告約瑟，約瑟就被關進監牢。
約瑟在監裏對法老的司酒長和膳食長說：「解夢不是出於神嗎？」
司酒長照約瑟所說的官復原職，卻把約瑟忘了兩年。
法老夢見七頭肥母牛和七頭瘦母牛，又夢見七個飽滿的穗子和七個細弱的穗子。
約瑟說神是在顯明：先有七個豐年，隨後有七個荒年。
法老派約瑟治理全埃及；約瑟積存糧食，天下的人都來買糧。

about.en: The king set Joseph free and made him lord
about.zh: 君王釋放約瑟，立他為主

about.en: God gave Joseph favor and wisdom before Pharaoh
about.zh: 神使約瑟在法老面前得恩寵和智慧

about.en: Daniel: a God in heaven reveals mysteries
about.zh: 但以理說：天上有一位神能顯明奧祕

en: "Pharaoh" comes from an Egyptian word meaning "great house"; Egyptian art shows officials given gold collars and fine linen.
Egypt's harvests depended on the yearly flooding of the Nile; when the flood was low, famine could follow.
On, where Joseph's father-in-law was priest, is Heliopolis, now in northeast Cairo.
zh: 「法老」源自埃及文，意思是「大房子」；埃及的壁畫描繪官員受賜金項圈和細麻衣。
埃及的收成取決於尼羅河每年的氾濫；氾濫水位低時，就可能發生饑荒。
約瑟岳父作祭司的安城，就是希里歐波利斯，在今開羅東北部。
